origin.description: Attach a handler that deferred_run() on the global frame will execute.
origin.details: In an interactive session the first global handler explains that it will not run until the session ends or deferred_run() is called. This check is not interactive.
origin.example:
bucket <- character()
add <- function(item) bucket <<- c(bucket, item)
global_defer(add("g1"))
global_defer(add("g2"), priority = "last")
deferred_run(.GlobalEnv)
bucket

translation.description: Attach a handler that deferred_run() on the global frame will execute.
translation.details: In an interactive session the first global handler explains that it will not run until the session ends or deferred_run() is called. This check is not interactive.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from withr import *

from withr._scope import GLOBAL
GLOBAL.clear()
bucket = []
global_defer(lambda: bucket.append("g1"))
global_defer(lambda: bucket.append("g2"), priority="last")
deferred_run(GLOBAL)
return bucket
